children: Enviro Infra Engineers share price will remain in focus on September 9 after its step-down subsidiary Suyog Urja Limited (SUL) secured an EPC turnkey contract worth Rs 189.99 crore.
Tata Power Renewable Energy awarded a contract for the development of a 180 MW NTPC wind power project at Parli, Maharashtra.

The contract covers WTG foundation works, supply of reinforcement steel and geotech, balance of plant (BoP) works, development of a 39-acre secure storage yard, ROW coordination, construction of permanent and temporary roads and crane pads, and 33kV transmission line works, including construction and commissioning.
The contract is scheduled to be executed by March 31, 2027.
Catch all the market action on our live blog
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 196.15, down Rs 1.90, or 0.96 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 276.05 and a 52-week low of Rs 135.00 on 22 September, 2025 and 09 March, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 28.94 percent below its 52-week high and 45.3 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 3,443.02 crore.

title: Enviro Infra Engineers shares in focus on contract win worth Rs 190 crore
